claim: Parameter-dependent callable-body inference is deterministic, passes every fixed production budget, restores exact dependency products across process restarts, and stays inside the accepted neutral comparison and representative warm-memory envelopes.

build.note: The baseline is the clean local-only detached commit recorded in callable-body-inference-baseline-2026-08-12.json. The candidate remained intentionally uncommitted in the user's working tree. Exact profiler hashes identify both measured binaries.

accepted_bounds.failure_policy: Every bound excess publishes callable_body_bound_exceeded. No body, capture, alias, type, or union member is truncated.

neutral_release_gate.fixed_budget_result: All five baseline and all five candidate runs passed every production budget.
neutral_release_gate.decision: Accepted: every named regression metric is within 3%; wall, CPU, and RSS improved, retained heap is effectively flat, and edit p95 is +1.79%.

representative_read_only_corpus.description: An anonymized two-project, read-only verification corpus. No corpus source was modified, copied, or added as a regression fixture. The corpus had grown since earlier same-day evidence, so this comparison freezes its current dataset fingerprint and uses exact isolated cache roots for each semantic producer identity.
representative_read_only_corpus.cache_acceptance: Every measured run reported 604 persistent gem-product hits, zero misses, zero producers, and zero corruptions.
representative_read_only_corpus.decision: Accepted: median wall improved, CPU and retained heap are within 3%, every cache lifecycle counter is clean, and all candidate RSS samples stay below the fixed warm-corpus ceiling. The +4.55% median RSS variance is recorded and governed by the fixed ceiling rather than hidden.

persistence_defect_and_fix.finding: The initial candidate encoded callable-body and higher-order persistence enums with Serde adjacent tagging. Postcard can encode that representation but cannot deserialize it, so affected gem products were rejected and rebuilt on every process restart.
persistence_defect_and_fix.observed_failure: Twenty affected products repeatedly reported `failed to decode persistent dependency product: This is a feature that PostCard will never implement` before the root cause was fixed.
persistence_defect_and_fix.fix: Use Postcard-compatible externally tagged persistence DTO enums and test actual Postcard bytes before restoring the domain snapshot.
persistence_defect_and_fix.producer_identity: The semantic producer fingerprint changed after the fix, forcing a disjoint product key and preventing selection of older invalid payloads.
persistence_defect_and_fix.post_fix_proof: A fresh population completed with zero corruptions; the next process restored 604/604 products with zero misses, producers, or corruptions. All ten accepted representative runs repeated that exact cache outcome.

measured_root_causes: Escape analysis recursively visited every assignment RHS and call even when no callable identity existed in the flow environment.
Static callable-literal recognition allocated a UTF-8 method-name string for ordinary call-shaped assignments.
accepted_changes: Return immediately from escape analysis when the callable environment is empty.
Match the three supported callable constructor names directly as bytes without allocation.
optimization.result: The exact final neutral five-pair candidate has edit p95 +1.79%, wall -10.77%, CPU -4.82%, RSS -1.03%, and retained heap +0.003% versus baseline.

correctness_evidence.workspace: The final cargo test --workspace passed every target after the persistence fix: root 1626/1628 with two intentional ignores, ruby-analysis 601/601, and all extension, integration, CLI, and doc targets passed.
correctness_evidence.focused: Callable-body black-box suite passed 50/50 including local and cross-file definition navigation; Postcard callable-body and higher-order persistence wire tests passed.
correctness_evidence.scorecard: The final explicit scorecard report passed 121/121 cases, scored 100/100, recorded zero gaps, and recorded zero unexpected outcomes.
correctness_evidence.review: The final architecture audit found no retained Prism nodes, consumer-owned callable inference, duplicate MRO/visibility policy, or parallel semantic store.
